tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run at chem_opt = 170 with Noah (data/eqwefic/chem170_scm, cu_physics = 16), the noah dump of step 1 (ctessum-claude/WRF branch earthsciml-instrumented-chem170). Inputs are the dumped Noah-driver arguments (real32 values widened). The FORCING assertions (q2, q2sat, dqsdt2, th2, lwdn, solnet, prcp) are against the values WRF's driver formed in REAL32 and handed SFLX, so they hold to real32 round-off: worst relative difference 2.3e-7 (dqsdt2) over these tests, bound rel 1e-6. fdown is SFLX's solnet + lwdn of those same real32 arguments (the replay's FDOWN), so it carries their round-off too (rel 1e-6), and q1 is against that replay's q1 = q2k + eta_kinematic cp/rch with eta_kinematic and rch from the same replay: the component forms q2 from qv in real64 while the replay used WRF's real32 q2k, a 7e-8 relative difference in q2 that reaches q1 diluted, hence rel 2e-7. albedo_in is the step's albedo_out, which on this snow-free column is the background albedo at every step (solnet confirms it at every daytime step). snow_branch_active is asserted zero at zero tolerance: the column is snow-free, so every quantity here is on the branch this component selects.
